fusions.name: Skimming Snatch
fusions.desc: Snatches the target from above for 14 damage, up to 2 times that at the full 8 tiles, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Glinting Darts
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 darts in a spread, each dealing 2 damage with a 25% chance of leaving the target [Leaden] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you and lifts you 3 tiles from where you stood. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Silvered Reflexes
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
